summary: ArcelorMittal filed a 6-K reporting the results of its Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings held on May 5, 2026. Shareholders approved a $0.60 per share dividend, re-elected and elected certain directors, approved the cancellation of shares repurchased under the buyback program, and renewed the authorization to increase share capital and suspend preemptive rights. This is a routine meeting results filing with no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of ordinary corporate governance matters.
